decision: On 2026-10-01 agalwood authorized corrective revisions until the first formal Release succeeds in response to the disclosed .4 scope and unchanged 42 residual Action advisories (1 Critical, 18 High, 19 Medium, 4 Low), retaining the 2026-10-15 UTC deadline. This fresh record binds only v9.0.2-motrix.7 to its exact source lock, every workflow byte, supporting assessment, complete same-day audit report and official full-SHA Action references. Formal .6 run 36858422887 passed all 22 preceding jobs, including both Windows finalizers. After human macOS Environment confirmation, decoding, PKCS12 import and unique valid Developer ID/Team checks passed, but both codesign identity lookups failed before a successful signature or notarization. Reuploading canonical Base64 and rerunning the same commit failed identically; no Secret contents were inspected or public Release created. The script omitted its temporary keychain from the user search list. The .7 correction snapshots that list before creation, parses bounded literal paths without evaluation, registers the owned keychain while preserving existing entries/order, and restores the original list before deletion on every exit. Cleanup failures cannot report success. Full production-script tests with public fake commands/data cover registration, setup/signing failures, create side effects, empty/literal-space/special-character paths, malformed inventories and restoration/deletion failures. They never touch a real keychain or credential, and do not claim an actual Developer ID signature. Native macOS required CI and secret-free pre-sign jobs run them before candidate download/approval. SHA1 identity selection, explicit --keychain, unique valid Developer ID, nonextractable keys, codesign-only access, internal Team/certificate pins, hardened runtime, timestamps and exact ZIP notarization remain. No default keychain, trust store, source archive/URL, toolchain, official Action commit, Secret name/permission or publication authority changes. Existing strict wrapped Base64 decoding, isolated Windows packaging/risk checks, native fresh packaging checks, protected binary-mode readers, deterministic macOS baseline and read-only bounded NASM evidence remain. Audit 36807648066 and its complete 42-advisory inventory are unchanged; none is claimed fixed or wholly unreachable, including cache service/extraction risks before validation and signature type-binding risk. Publication remains conditional on all required exact-commit CI checks, file/race/size/hash guards, independent clean rebuilds, Developer ID signing/notarization, Ed25519 authentication, independent final verification, Immutable Releases and fresh protected-Environment confirmations. All six prior annotated tags stay immutable; no previous hash binding or Environment approval is reused. Further corrective revisions need fresh exact-scope records. New advisories, deadline extensions or unrelated source/Action updates need a new human decision. This limited record grants no Environment approval, no exception for another tag or unrecorded scope, and no publication after the deadline.
